question: After the packaged built-in OAuth control and the internal website draft, which Google release gates are currently satisfied and which still require external action?
kind: Read-only release-closure audit of repository, GitHub Actions, Google Auth Platform and one run-owned Shared Drive. No Cloud setting, Drive permission or provider item was changed.

repository.oauth_site_state: An internal static homepage, Google-data privacy page and data-removal guide are merged. Every page remains visibly marked as an internal draft, carries noindex and has unresolved operator placeholders. The release validator rejects it as designed.
repository.package_build_input: The repository Actions secret exists. A fresh main workflow and the exact-artifact control both passed without emitting the value.
repository.effective_google_read_result: Two active My Drive connections completed the corrected bounded GET-only adapter-versus-mount comparison over ten exact ordinary files and 5,896,611 bytes with no byte mismatch, unavailable read, or content, metadata or namespace change. The unregistered diagnostic remains troubleshooting evidence rather than a release gate.

google_auth_platform.pending_change: The exact full Drive scope remains undeclared. A previous browser form selection was never applied or saved and that transient form is no longer open. Adding the scope and saving the Cloud configuration still require action-time owner confirmation.
google_auth_platform.read_only_console_recheck: The live console still shows External / Testing, two test users, no homepage, privacy-policy or terms URL, zero authorized domains, and no production verification requirement while the app remains in Testing. No field was changed.

shared_drive_role_inventory.method: One bounded Drive permissions.list request against the exact private test Shared Drive; response fields were restricted to type, role, deleted and pendingOwner. No raw response, identity, email, token or provider ID was printed or recorded.
shared_drive_role_inventory.implication: No second member with a reader, commenter, contributor, content-manager or other restricted role exists in this test drive. Restricted-role acceptance cannot be run until a second Workspace member is deliberately added.

satisfied_now: Built-in Desktop OAuth input reaches successful DEB, RPM and Arch artifacts.
A reviewable internal homepage, privacy policy and removal guide exist with an accidental-publication guard.
Read-only and write-mode scope justifications and the verification demonstration sequence are documented.
Google Docs and Sheets APIs are enabled and representative native export fidelity has bounded live evidence.
still_open: Save the full Drive scope declaration after explicit action-time confirmation.
Choose and verify an operator-controlled domain, replace operator placeholders, review the policy text, publish the site and configure matching branding URLs.
Add a second Workspace member with deliberately restricted Shared Drive roles before running that role matrix.
Submit branding and restricted-scope verification to Google with an approved end-to-end demonstration; Google decides whether an external security assessment is required.
Broader arbitrary native-document fidelity and concurrent native writeback remain outside the currently implemented read-only native-package boundary.
